products.name: NOBLE
products.desc: A refined citrus-aromatic composition with lavender, honey and tobacco warmth. Created for quiet confidence — the scent that completes your style without saying a word.

products.name: BLAZE
products.desc: An energetic amber-woody rush — blood orange and pink pepper over magnetic amber. Wear it for the night out, the date, the moment you want to be remembered.

products.name: PETALS
products.desc: A soft yet mysterious floral — peony and Turkish rose wrapped in dark musk. Elegant restraint with a lingering trail. A quiet moment of me-time, bottled.

products.name: PEARLS
products.desc: Luminous white florals with sparkling aldehydes and creamy sandalwood. Sophisticated light — a touch-up after lunch, a fragrance before an important meeting.

products.name: ELIXIR
products.desc: A rich, enveloping oriental — saffron, oud and amber wrapped in vanilla. Sensual depth for nights that become memories. Notify me on launch.
